description: The `DRGCODES` table contains information about Diagnosis Related Groups (DRGs) assigned to hospital admissions. It provides details such as the DRG code, a description of the DRG, the type of DRG, and associated severity and mortality risks. The table links DRG information to patient identifiers (`SUBJECT_ID`) and hospital admission identifiers (`HADM_ID`). This data can be used to analyze the types of hospital cases, resource utilization, and patient outcomes associated with different DRGs.

columns.name: ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each row in the table.

columns.name: HADM_ID
columns.description: Hospital admission identifier. Each HADM_ID represents a unique admission to the hospital.

columns.name: DRG_TYPE
columns.description: The type of Diagnosis Related Group. DRG is a system to classify hospital cases into one of several groups, with similar clinical conditions requiring similar resource usage.

columns.name: DRG_CODE
columns.description: Numeric code representing the DRG (Diagnosis Related Group) assigned to the patient's hospital stay.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of the DRG (Diagnosis Related Group).

columns.name: DRG_SEVERITY
columns.description: Severity level associated with the DRG (Diagnosis Related Group), which indicates the complexity or seriousness of the patient's condition.

columns.name: DRG_MORTALITY
columns.description: Mortality risk associated with the DRG (Diagnosis Related Group). Higher values indicate a greater risk of mortality for patients assigned to that DRG.

relationships.reason: DRGCODES.SUBJECT_ID references PATIENTS.SUBJECT_ID. This represents the patient to whom the DRG code is assigned.
DRGCODES.HADM_ID references ADMISSIONS.HADM_ID. This represents the hospital admission to which the DRG code is assigned.
